explanations.collectsData: The NDP Act applies to any processing of personal data of Nigerian citizens.
explanations.sensitiveData: Section 30 requires special protection for sensitive personal data.
explanations.hasPrivacyPolicy: Section 27 requires a transparent and easily accessible privacy policy.
explanations.crossBorderTransfer: Sections 41-43 restrict data transfers to countries with adequate protection levels.
explanations.hasConsentMechanism: Section 26 requires specific, informed, and unambiguous consent.
explanations.targetsChildren: Section 31 requires age verification and parental consent for users under 18.
explanations.thirdPartySharing: Section 25 requires data processing agreements with third-party processors.
explanations.hasBreachProcess: Section 40 requires reporting data breaches within 72 hours to NDPC.
explanations.registeredWithNDPC: Section 44 requires registration as a data controller/processor of major importance.
explanations.usesAI: GAID 2025 Article 15 requires transparency for automated decision-making.
